chapters.title: Chapter 1: The Middle Zone of Hybrid War

episode.tagline: War has changed. Sometimes, an act of war doesn't seem like war at all. Often it can't be detected, or attributed, or responded to. It's a messy world.
episode.about: In this episode, Ajay lays out the many kinds of Hybrid Warfare in this modern world -- and the incentives that drive them.
